rows.commentary: 3.4: Mrittunjoy Chowdhury delivers to Jarvis, who dispatches it high and handsome over deep extra cover for a maximum.
3.5: No run for Jarvis off Mrittunjoy Chowdhury.
3.6: Mrittunjoy Chowdhury pitches it up again, and Jarvis answers with another brutal strike sailing all the way over sweeper cover.
4.1: Chowdhury Md Rizwan bowls to Finlay McCreath, who launches a thunderous blow soaring out toward deep mid-wicket for six.
4.2: Chowdhury Md Rizwan strays slightly, allowing Finlay McCreath to pierce the field smartly as it races away to deep backward point for four.
4.3: Chowdhury Md Rizwan serves it up to Finlay McCreath, who answers with an authoritative loft clearing long-off with ease.
4.4: Wide from Chowdhury Md Rizwan to Finlay McCreath.
4.4: Chowdhury Md Rizwan feels the relentless assault as Finlay McCreath deposits this delivery deep into the stands over long-on.
4.5: Dot ball from Chowdhury Md Rizwan to Finlay McCreath.
4.6: Chowdhury Md Rizwan watches helplessly as Finlay McCreath unleashes absolute power, pulling it disdainfully over deep mid-wicket for another maximum.
5.1: Habibur Rahman Sohan keeps it tight as Jarvis flicks the ball smoothly down to long on to pick up a single.
5.2: Habibur Rahman Sohan floats one up, and Finlay McCreath feasts on it, launching it majestically over long-off for six.
5.3: Mackenzie Jones does not score off Habibur Rahman Sohan.
5.4: Habibur Rahman Sohan strikes gold as Mackenzie Jones falls for a duck, safely caught by Abu Hider.
5.5: Habibur Rahman Sohan tests Finlay McCreath, who nudges it safely towards short mid-wicket to rotate the strike with a single.
5.6: Habibur Rahman Sohan ends the over on a sour note as Jarvis muscles it high over deep mid-wicket to clear the rope for six.
